_comment: Tier-1 fallback (shipped-with-wallet). Mirrored from the release pipeline at build time. The chain-anchored overlay served via /v1/sites/installers.monerousd.org/manifest replaces this whenever the site-updater detects a newer SITE_PUBLISH on the USDm chain. The wallet's checkSovereignUpgrade(currentVersion) compares manifest.version semver-style — same-or-older returns upgradeAvailable=false, newer returns upgradeAvailable=true.
